name: Reihi Sousou - The Knight of Ellewsmille
original_name: 隷妃双奏 The Knight of Ellewsmille
source:
One sister is summoned to become emperor's princess while another one becomes a slave in the arena. Main character learns this secret and subjects both sisters to extreme shame.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名姐妹被召唤成为皇帝的公主，另一名则成为江湖上的奴隶。主角得知这个秘密后，两姐妹都蒙受了极大的羞辱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
